summary.headline: Lot of Events and Weather Judgments
summary.text: Judicial astrology instructions on judging clouds, rain, and weather from conjunctions of the Moon with moist planets, followed by almanac tables using planetary house angles, Indian and Abjad numerals, and Aries-based degrees. The Lot of Events is calculated from the Sun, Moon, and Saturn almanacs and interpreted through conjunctions, oppositions, squares, planetary houses, and signs including Aquarius and Sagittarius.
